summary: Reconcile an approved Kubernetes context with a sanitized local observation and report identity and access limits.
limitations: Approval, context selection, cluster facts, and access observations are operator assertions, not independently verified.
A Namespace UID is an object identity anchor and does not prove a universal cluster identity.
No kubeconfig, kubectl, cluster API, node, control-plane, or admission-controller integration is exercised.
The report never authorizes live execution or establishes security posture, exploitability, or complete coverage.

demo.description: Verify matching, limited-evidence, and rejected context-switch playbacks through the offline CLI.
